Proposed time: July 18, 09:30–12:30 — agenda draft: 09:30 arrival & badging, 09:45 security & lab safety, 10:00 demo, 11:15 ops QA, 11:45 next steps + lunch.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Karthik on badging & lockers (monica, please confirm catering).
